verdict.rationale: TruffleHog cuts noise indirectly. `--only-verified` and `--results=verified,unknown` limit alerts to live or likely-live secrets, which suppresses many false positives. `--since-commit HEAD` restricts scans to new commits, so in hook and CI use only newly introduced secrets fail the build. Missing for 10: an explicit baseline file or allowlist of existing findings, a per-finding ignore or false-positive marking mechanism (e.g., inline ignore comments or path exclusions), and independent corroboration of triage workflows.
